settings.intro_text:
A slow internet connection isn't always your internet provider's fault.

Sometimes, the real problem is the router sitting quietly on a shelf, struggling to keep up with everything you've connected to it. Between 4K streaming, video calls, online gaming, smart home devices, and multiple people using Wi-Fi at the same time, today's homes demand much more than routers from a few years ago were built to handle.

That's where the TP-Link BE6500 Dual-Band WiFi 7 Router (BE400) comes in.

As one of TP-Link's newer WiFi 7 routers, it promises faster speeds, lower latency, and better performance for busy households. But unless you're a networking enthusiast, "WiFi 7" probably doesn't mean much on its own.

So, is upgrading actually worth it?

Here's what it's like to live with the BE6500—and who will benefit from making the switch.
